title: Cold-water swimming
paragraphs: We all know about the health benefits of swimming. It offers a great workout for the body – it builds endurance, muscle strength and cardiovascular fitness. If you don’t mind getting wet, it can be fun too. But who would enjoy swimming in water that’s ice cold? Well, many people are taking the plunge, based on evidence that it can actually be good for us.

Cold-water swimming – sometimes called wild swimming – involves swimming in natural areas including ponds, rivers and the sea. Jumping in gives a short sharp shock to the body, but many participants say they get used to it. A cold dip might wake you up, but research has found it can have much bigger benefits than that for your body and mind. As well as being good exercise, spending time outdoors and by water improves wellbeing.

There is much evidence, mostly anecdotal, that suggests cold-water swimming has cured certain health conditions. One man who suffered constant pain after surgery claimed he was cured by taking a plunge in cold open water. And another swimmer, Sandria Simons, told the BBC “the immersion of your body in cold, salt water, just feeling like you’re at one with nature if you like, just feels amazing.” But what is it that people are gaining from this chilly experience? Doctors say getting into cold water evokes a stress response, but the more you do it, your reaction to stress is reduced. It’s also thought to have a strong anti-inflammatory effect. But there are bigger benefits to this stress-reducing exercise. Some experts believe cold-water swimming helps ‘cross-adaptation’, where one form of stress prepares the body for another. For example, it also helps reduce the stress of exercising at high altitude.
So, if you’re convinced that this is for you, take advice: approach it with caution, swim with a friend, and maybe start in the summer, when the water temperatures are higher!

vocabulary.entry: endurance /ɪnˈdjʊərəns/ n. 耐力
vocabulary.example: Long-distance running is a test of endurance.
vocabulary.translation: 长跑是对耐力的考验。

vocabulary.entry: muscle strength /ˈmʌsl streŋθ/ n. 肌肉力量
vocabulary.example: Regular weight training can improve muscle strength.
vocabulary.translation: 规律的力量训练能增强肌肉力量。

vocabulary.entry: cardiovascular fitness /ˌkɑːdiəʊˈvæskjələ ˈfɪtnəs/ n. 心血管健康
vocabulary.example: Cycling is an excellent way to boost cardiovascular fitness.
vocabulary.translation: 骑自行车是提升心血管健康的绝佳方式。

vocabulary.entry: take the plunge /teɪk ðə plʌndʒ/ 果断尝试；大胆行动
vocabulary.example: After months of hesitation, she finally took the plunge and started her own business.
vocabulary.translation: 犹豫了数月后，她终于下定决心创业。

vocabulary.entry: cold-water swimming /ˌkəʊld ˈwɔːtə ˈswɪmɪŋ/ n. 冷水游泳
vocabulary.example: Cold-water swimming has become increasingly popular in recent years.
vocabulary.translation: 近年来冷水游泳变得越来越受欢迎。

vocabulary.entry: wild swimming /waɪld ˈswɪmɪŋ/ n. 野外游泳
vocabulary.example: Wild swimming in lakes and rivers is a popular activity in summer.
vocabulary.translation: 在湖泊和河流里野外游泳是夏季的热门活动。

vocabulary.entry: pond /pɒnd/ n. 池塘
vocabulary.example: The children like to feed the ducks in the pond.
vocabulary.translation: 孩子们喜欢在池塘里喂鸭子。

vocabulary.entry: sharp shock /ʃɑːp ʃɒk/ n. 强烈刺激
vocabulary.example: The sudden loud noise gave me a sharp shock.
vocabulary.translation: 突如其来的巨响吓了我一大跳。

vocabulary.entry: participant /pɑːˈtɪsɪpənt/ n. 参与者
vocabulary.example: Each participant was given a certificate of completion.
vocabulary.translation: 每位参与者都拿到了结业证书。

vocabulary.entry: cold dip /kəʊld dɪp/ n. 冷水浴
vocabulary.example: A cold dip in the morning can help you wake up quickly.
vocabulary.translation: 早晨冲个冷水浴能帮你快速清醒。

vocabulary.entry: wellbeing /ˈwelbiːɪŋ/ n. 健康；幸福感
vocabulary.example: Spending time in nature is good for mental wellbeing.
vocabulary.translation: 亲近自然有益于心理健康。

vocabulary.entry: anecdotal /ˌænəkˈdəʊtl/ adj. 坊间的；传闻的
vocabulary.example: The evidence for the treatment is purely anecdotal.
vocabulary.translation: 这种疗法的证据纯属传闻。

vocabulary.entry: constant pain /ˈkɒnstənt peɪn/ n. 持续疼痛
vocabulary.example: The patient complained of constant pain in his lower back.
vocabulary.translation: 这位患者主诉腰部持续疼痛。

vocabulary.entry: immersion /ɪˈmɜːʃn/ n. 浸入；沉浸
vocabulary.example: Total immersion in a foreign language is the best way to learn it.
vocabulary.translation: 完全沉浸在一门外语环境中是学习它的最佳方式。

vocabulary.entry: be at one with nature /bi æt wʌn wɪð ˈneɪtʃə/ 与自然融为一体
vocabulary.example: When I'm hiking in the mountains, I feel at one with nature.
vocabulary.translation: 当我在山里徒步时，我会感觉与自然融为一体。

vocabulary.entry: chilly /ˈtʃɪli/ adj. 寒冷的；凉飕飕的
vocabulary.example: We need to wear coats on this chilly autumn morning.
vocabulary.translation: 在这个凉爽的秋日早晨，我们需要穿上外套。

vocabulary.entry: evoke /ɪˈvəʊk/ v. 引发；唤起
vocabulary.example: The smell of freshly baked bread evokes memories of my childhood.
vocabulary.translation: 新鲜出炉的面包香味唤起了我童年的回忆。

vocabulary.entry: stress response /stres rɪˈspɒns/ n. 应激反应
vocabulary.example: The body's stress response helps it deal with dangerous situations.
vocabulary.translation: 身体的应激反应有助于应对危险情况。

vocabulary.entry: anti-inflammatory effect /ˌænti ɪnˈflæmətri ɪˈfekt/ n. 抗炎效果
vocabulary.example: Turmeric is believed to have anti-inflammatory effects.
vocabulary.translation: 姜黄被认为具有抗炎效果。

vocabulary.entry: cross-adaptation /ˌkrɒs ˌædæpˈteɪʃn/ n. 交叉适应
vocabulary.example: Cross-adaptation allows the body to handle different types of stress better.
vocabulary.translation: 交叉适应能让身体更好地应对不同类型的压力。

vocabulary.entry: high altitude /haɪ ˈæltɪtjuːd/ n. 高海拔
vocabulary.example: Many people suffer from altitude sickness at high altitude.
vocabulary.translation: 许多人在高海拔地区会出现高原反应。

vocabulary.entry: approach with caution /əˈprəʊtʃ wɪð ˈkɔːʃn/ 谨慎对待；小心尝试
vocabulary.example: You should approach this new project with caution.
vocabulary.translation: 你应该谨慎对待这个新项目。

sentences.english: We all know about the health benefits of swimming.
sentences.chinese: 我们都知道游泳对健康的益处。

sentences.english: It offers a great workout for the body – it builds endurance, muscle strength and cardiovascular fitness.
sentences.chinese: 它是一项极佳的全身运动，能增强耐力、肌肉力量和心血管健康水平。

sentences.english: If you don’t mind getting wet, it can be fun too.
sentences.chinese: 如果你不介意被打湿，游泳还能带来不少乐趣。

sentences.english: But who would enjoy swimming in water that’s ice cold?
sentences.chinese: 但有谁会喜欢在冰冷刺骨的水里游泳呢？

sentences.english: Well, many people are taking the plunge, based on evidence that it can actually be good for us.
sentences.chinese: 事实上，许多人都开始尝试这项运动，因为有证据表明，冷水游泳对我们的身体其实大有裨益。

sentences.english: Cold-water swimming – sometimes called wild swimming – involves swimming in natural areas including ponds, rivers and the sea.
sentences.chinese: 冷水游泳——有时也被称为野外游泳——指的是在池塘、河流、大海等自然水域中游泳。

sentences.english: Jumping in gives a short sharp shock to the body, but many participants say they get used to it.
sentences.chinese: 跳入冷水的瞬间，身体会受到强烈的刺激，但许多参与者表示，他们会适应了这种感觉。

sentences.english: A cold dip might wake you up, but research has found it can have much bigger benefits than that for your body and mind.
sentences.chinese: 冷水浴或许能让人瞬间清醒，但研究发现，它对身心的益处远不止于此。

sentences.english: As well as being good exercise, spending time outdoors and by water improves wellbeing.
sentences.chinese: 除了是一种很好的运动方式外，待在户外、亲近水域也能提升身心健康水平。

sentences.english: There is much evidence, mostly anecdotal, that suggests cold-water swimming has cured certain health conditions.
sentences.chinese: 有大量证据——其中大部分是坊间传闻——表明冷水游泳能治愈某些健康问题。

sentences.english: One man who suffered constant pain after surgery claimed he was cured by taking a plunge in cold open water.
sentences.chinese: 一名术后长期受疼痛困扰的男子称，在户外冷水中游泳后，他的疼痛就痊愈了。

sentences.english: And another swimmer, Sandria Simons, told the BBC “the immersion of your body in cold, salt water, just feeling like you’re at one with nature if you like, just feels amazing.”
sentences.chinese: 另一位游泳爱好者桑德里亚·西蒙斯在接受BBC采访时表示：“将身体浸入冰冷的海水中，那种与自然融为一体的感觉，真的太棒了。”

sentences.english: But what is it that people are gaining from this chilly experience?
sentences.chinese: 但人们究竟能从这种寒冷的体验中获得什么呢？

sentences.english: Doctors say getting into cold water evokes a stress response, but the more you do it, your reaction to stress is reduced.
sentences.chinese: 医生表示，浸入冷水会引发身体的应激反应，但随着尝试次数增多，身体对压力的反应会逐渐减弱。

sentences.english: It’s also thought to have a strong anti-inflammatory effect.
sentences.chinese: 冷水游泳还被认为具有显著的抗炎效果。

sentences.english: But there are bigger benefits to this stress-reducing exercise. Some experts believe cold-water swimming helps ‘cross-adaptation’, where one form of stress prepares the body for another.
sentences.chinese: 而这项减压运动还有更重要的益处，一些专家认为，冷水游泳有助于实现“交叉适应”，即一种压力可以让身体为应对另一种压力做好准备。

sentences.english: For example, it also helps reduce the stress of exercising at high altitude.
sentences.chinese: 例如，它也能帮助减轻在高海拔地区运动时产生的压力。

sentences.english: So, if you’re convinced that this is for you, take advice: approach it with caution, swim with a friend, and maybe start in the summer, when the water temperatures are higher!
sentences.chinese: 所以，如果你确定自己想尝试冷水游泳，不妨遵循以下建议：务必谨慎尝试，最好结伴而行，或许可以从水温相对较高的夏季开始！
